title: Payee Bank Details — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: For a paying bank, the code it uses for each other bank in its salary transfer file. When the transfer file is produced for a paying bank, each employee's bank is looked up here to find the code to write.

fields.label: Bank
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Bank master data.

fields.label: PayeeBank
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Bank master data.
fields.html: What it is. The employee's bank — the bank being paid into.

fields.label: BankCode
fields.html:
What it is. The code the paying bank uses for the employee's bank.

Why it matters. Written into the paying bank's salary transfer file for every employee paid into that bank.

fields.label: BankFile
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Bank File master data.
fields.html:
What it is. A bank file format for this pairing.

Why it matters. Not read at present — the salary transfer file does not use it.
